question: As of February 2024, who among the following is the Deputy Chairman of Rajya Sabha?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Harivansh Narayan Singh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Harivansh Narayan **Singh is the Deputy Chairman of Rajya Sabha as of February 2024.
 
• Harivansh Narayan Singh has been serving as the Deputy Chairman of Rajya Sabha since 2018.
 
• He is a member of the Janata Dal (United) party and has been re-elected to the position multiple times.
 
• The Deputy Chairman presides over the Rajya Sabha in the absence of the Vice President of India, who is the ex-officio Chairman.
 
• His role is crucial in maintaining order and ensuring the smooth functioning of the House.
 
• He is known for his impartiality and deep understanding of parliamentary procedures.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jagat Prakash Nadda** :

 
 
• Jagat Prakash Nadda is the National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) as of February 2024.
 
• He has held various ministerial positions in the past, including Minister of Health and Family Welfare.
 
• He is not associated with the Rajya Sabha Deputy Chairmanship.
 
• Nadda is primarily involved in organizational and political activities of the BJP.
 
• His role is more focused on party leadership rather than parliamentary duties.
 
 
 
• **Dharmendra Pradhan**:
 
 
• Dharmendra Pradhan is a senior BJP leader and currently serves as the Minister of Education and Skill Development.
 
• He has been a member of both the Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha in the past.
 
• Pradhan is not the Deputy Chairman of Rajya Sabha.
 
• He is known for his work in the energy and education sectors.
 
• His current responsibilities are centered around policy-making and governance.
 
 
 
• **Prakash Javadekar** :
 
 
• Prakash Javadekar is a senior BJP leader and former Union Minister.
 
• He has served as the Minister of Information and Broadcasting, Environment, and Heavy Industries.
 
• Javadekar is not the Deputy Chairman of Rajya Sabha.
 
• He has been a member of the Rajya Sabha but is not currently holding the Deputy Chairmanship.
 
• His contributions are primarily in the fields of environment and media policies.
